comments.author: DrakiaXYZ Staff
comments.body_html:
The virus detection is a false positive, server mods (Which this is) are plain-text TypeScript files, you can open the source yourself and see that all it’s doing is updating some string values.

Every time a new SPT update comes out, a slew of mods update, and a good chunk of them get flagged by some random no-name third party antivirus. At the end of the day it’s up to each user to verify the validity of both an antivirus flag, as well as an authors claims

comments.author: AphEX
comments.body_html:
I imagine it’s probably not a problem with the length of the text, but rather simply the amount of extracts on certain maps when all of them are available. If I were playing with the normal amount of extracts, I’m sure it wouldn’t be an issue as even on Shoreline or Factory I can see all of the extracts.

Seems like the graphic can only display 11 extracts + transits. On maps that have more than that, Customs, Woods, and Streets, then that last 1 or 2 transits get clipped out. I imagine the only solution to that is somehow extending the graphic vertically to be able to display 13 extracts, which is the max amount of PMC extracts on Streets.

Once again, keep in mind this is only an issue for those of us playing with all extracts enabled regardless of where on the map you spawn. I play with Raid Overhaul and will often wander across the whole map so I like to be able to extract anywhere even if it’s right next to where I spawned. For people who play with extracts like vanilla Tarkov, they’ll probably never run into this issue as the game just won’t have to display as many extracts for them.
